correctness.rationale: The overlap integrals give the stated piecewise sine form; for delay at least 1 the remaining sinc zeros are simple. In the lower strip set r=(2−τ)/τ and T=πτν. At nonzero Doppler a multiple zero of F=sin(rT)−2sin T must satisfy 4(sin² T+r⁻² cos² T)=1. This excludes 1<r<2. At r=2 the factorization 2sin T(cos T−1) gives simple odd multiples, cubic nonzero even multiples, and a quadratic zero at ν=0 after division by πν. For r>2 the multiple zeros have F_TT=−2(r²−1)sin T≠0 and F_r=T cos(rT)≠0, giving regular nodal points, nondegenerate folds, and an isolated simultaneous-zero set of (F,F_T). At ν=0 the sole nodal point has A_τ=−3. The density step is valid: the rescaled maps near the irrational-flow recurrence converge in C¹ and have an invertible limiting Jacobian. Independently, choose first-quadrant phases θ(r),φ(r) with sin²θ=(r²−4)/(4(r²−1)), sinφ=2sinθ and cosφ=2cosθ/r. Then T=2πn+θ is a double-zero frequency whenever 2πnr+rθ−φ is a multiple of 2π. Its derivative in r is 2πn+θ, so on every fixed open r-interval inside (2,∞) the image contains such a multiple for large n. The frozen CHECKER.py and CHECKER_OUTPUT.txt were inspected but not executed. A separate high-precision solve recovered the three logged delays (approximately 0.51108368717, 0.60125992786, 0.50581267973) with |F|, |F_T| and |A| below 3×10⁻⁶⁰ and nonzero F_r and F_TT. Those spot checks corroborate folds, not density or completeness. Joint analyticity is only asserted for 0<τ<1; density is not a fixed-band statement.
